title: Blood Meridian: Or the Evening Redness in the West (Vintage International)
author: Cormac McCarthy and Marlon James

highlights.text: He lies in drink, he quotes from poets whose names are now lost.
They fight with fists, with feet, with bottles or knives. All races, all breeds. Men whose speech sounds like the grunting of apes.
They is four things that can destroy the earth, he said. Women, whiskey, money, and niggers.
The way of the transgressor is hard. God made this world, but he didnt make it to suit everbody, did he? I dont believe he much had me in mind.

A man’s at odds to know his mind cause his mind is aught he has to know it with. He can know his heart, but he dont want to. Rightly so. Best not to look in there. It aint the heart of a creature that is bound in the way that God has set for it. You can find meanness in the least of creatures, but when God made man the devil was at his elbow. A creature that can do anything.
Make a machine. And a machine to make the machine. And evil that can run itself a thousand years, no need to tend it. You believe that?

What we are dealing with, he said, is a race of degenerates. A mongrel race, little better than niggers. And maybe no better. There is no government in Mexico. Hell, there’s no God in Mexico. Never will be. We are dealing with a people manifestly incapable of governing themselves. And do you know what happens with people who cannot govern themselves? That’s right. Others come in to govern for them.

The wrath of God lies sleeping. It was hid a million years before men were and only men have power to wake it. Hell aint half full. Hear me. Ye carry war of a madman’s making onto a foreign land. Ye’ll wake more than the dogs.
When the lambs is lost in the mountain, he said. They is cry. Sometime come the mother. Sometime the wolf.
